name: Cursor plugins
short: Cursor's official plugins, from GitHub and Gmail to HubSpot and Salesforce.
what: The official source for Cursor's marketplace plugins: about 85 plugins that bundle skills, rules, commands and connectors. They range from coding workflows to connectors for apps like Gmail, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce and Playwright. It's also the reference if you want to build your own.
who: Cursor users who want ready-made connectors and workflows, and developers who want to make and publish their own Cursor plugins.
needs: An account with any app you connect, such as HubSpot or Salesforce. Some plugins ask you to sign in to that service

steps.title: Install from inside Cursor
steps.text: Cursor's docs: open Customize in the sidebar, find the plugin you want, select Install and choose whether it's for this project or for you everywhere. You can also browse cursor.com/marketplace.

steps.title: Or install from Agent chat
steps.text: Plugins can also be added by name in Agent chat. For example, the plugin that helps you build your own:

try.label: Suggested
try.text: Install the connector for an app you already use from Customize, then ask the agent a question about your data in it. If you build tools, try /add-plugin create-plugin, then /create-plugin with a name and what it should do.

watch: Some plugins can trade or move money, including Robinhood, Coinbase, eToro and X Money. Don't give an agent write access to financial accounts.
Connectors can read your email, CRM and files. Choose project or user scope carefully.
Cursor's docs say marketplace plugins are reviewed before listing. Plugins from other community sites aren't covered by that.
